Anya: Heads-up — ACME pilot just told sales they need SSO + per-tenant quotas before GA. We need a rapid decision on what can actually go in MVP and what's pushed to v1. Any quick tradeoff ideas?
Dave: From eng: basic OAuth SSO looks like ~1.5w. Native per-tenant quota engine is more involved (4–6w). If we do a soft-limiter/telemetry only, that's ~2w.
Meera: CS says ACME won't sign GA without quotas + SSO, but they're open to a clearly-labeled beta flow for early tenants. They want a decommission commitment.
Sam: My 2c: ship OAuth SSO for MVP, provide a temporary edge-based quota (rate-limiter) + heavy telemetry, then migrate quotas to native engine in v1. That reduces user-facing risk.
Dave: Concretely: OAuth (authN) + token mapping -> 1.5w. Edge soft-quotas + telemetry -> 2w. Native quota engine -> 4–6w. Combined MVP+edge path delays GA by one sprint if we parallelize some infra work.
Anya: Could we do a proxy shim as @Sam suggests? Quick NGINX or Envoy rate-limit per-tenant header, annotated in docs that it's temporary.
Luis: Proxy shim is doable but ops debt. Need a clear cutlist: how we rip it out and what signals indicate we must keep it. Also need to ensure keys/secret handling doesn't bypass KMS rules.
Meera: CS will accept proxy as long as we have a decommission timeline and monthly updates. They also want an SLA clause for quota violation response time.
Sam: Rollout plan idea: feature-flag for edge-quotas + canary on 3 tenants, add alerting for quota fallback. If any issue, we flip the flag and fall back to per-tenant soft-warning (no hard rejects).
Dave: I'll draft a cutlist + tasks in a PR:
- MVP: OAuth SSO, edge soft-quota proxy, feature-flag, telemetry + alerts
- v1: native quota engine, RBAC for tenant admin, SLA tests, remove proxy
I'll include estimated sprints and owners.
Anya: Awesome. @Dave please include rollback playbook (how to disable proxy, who paged, mitigations) and gating criteria for removing proxy. Schedule a 30m sync tomorrow 10am to review the PR.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for tenant-acme at 2024-04-12T10:15:00Z (canary=3 tenants).
